ios.desc:
Famnom is an easy-to-use nutrition tracker and meal planner designed to help you understand your family's food and nutrition. Choose from a curated database of hundreds of thousands of foods to log meals, or create and manage your own customized foods and recipes. Learn about nutritional value of foods and recipes, and use that knowledge to reach your health goals. Sync nutrition data to Apple Health - calories, vitamins and minerals. Set your specific nutrition goals for calories, macros (protein, fat, carbohydrates), vitamins and minerals, or choose from FDA Recommended Daily Intake (RDI).

Log food: Easy-to-use tools make food, recipe and meal tracking simple.
Search foods: Lookup foods by name, brands or scan barcodes from a database of hundreds of thousands of foods, or add your own.
Custom Nutrition Goals: Set up daily goals for calories, vitamins and minerals, or use FDAs recommended values. See nutrient consumption and percentage breakdowns per day.
Mealplans: Get food suggestions based on your taste and nutrition preferences using our meal planning tools.
Know your foods: Understand your diet better through nutrition labels for foods and recipes. Get in control of your diet by using our tools to figure out foods rich in Calcium, Magnesium, Vitamin D, Zinc, etc. Nutrition data is sourced from USDA FDC: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/. For e.g nutrition data for Spinach: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/fdc-app.html#/food-details/1999633/nutrients.

quotes.text:
Hi everyone, I’m the author of Famnom. I built it after trying various nutrition tracking apps but didn’t find anything that fit my needs.

What is it?

Famnom is an easy-to-use macro and micro-nutrient tracker, and meal planner. Choose from a database of foods or add your own, create recipes and log meals. Set custom nutrition goals or use FDA RDIs for macros - calories, fats, proteins, carbs and micro-nutrients - Magnesium, Calcium, Zinc, Iron, etc. Use MealPlanner to generate daily meal plans based on nutrition goals, available items and taste preferences. Sample user journeys:

Signup/Login: https://github.com/umangsh/famnom/blob/master/journeys/signup_login_flow.gif

Search/Setup Kitchen: https://github.com/umangsh/famnom/blob/master/journeys/search_kitchen_flow.gif

Nutrition Goals: https://github.com/umangsh/famnom/blob/master/journeys/nutrition_goals_flow.gif

Mealplanner: https://github.com/umangsh/famnom/blob/master/journeys/mealplanner_flow.gif

Why?

My main goal was to eliminate nutritional supplements in my diet, and use fresh foods and recipes as much as possible. Famnom can help:

1. Track macro nutrients and micro nutrients, such as Vitamin D, Fiber, Magnesium, etc consumed per day. Connect with Apple Health for trends over longer periods of time.

2. Generate meal plans based on available foods and recipes in Kitchen, nutrition preferences and taste preferences.

3. Share kitchens with other family members.
